info.title: Knowledge graph L2: Decision-Support Logic API
info.description: DAK component 6. The whole model is an id, an optional description and `source 1..1 uri` to a DMN file. Nothing about the decision itself -- which is the gap the l2-dmn subgraph fills. resolutionStatus is `unresolved` on a component that something else names but no DAK declares -- an L3 artefact whose title carries the component id, for instance. The node exists so the gap is queryable and carries the referenced id and nothing else. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/decision-support-logic.
